# `hk util check-byte-order-marker`

- **How to hail it:** `hk util check-byte-order-marker [-d --diff] <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** read-only (looks, never touches)

Checks the cargo for a UTF-8 byte order marker (BOM).

## Cargo it takes {#arguments}

- **`<FILES>…`** — The files to check

## Flags to fly {#flags}

- **`-d --diff`** — Write out a diff of the BOM removal instead of the file name
- **`-h --help`** — Print help, for when ye've lost yer bearings

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Tales from the deck {#examples}

Look for a byte order marker and leave the file be.

```sh
hk util check-byte-order-marker README.md
```
